item.title: First US LNG cargo for Bulgaria arrives in Alexandroupolis
item.description: METLEN has delivered its first US LNG cargo in Alexandroupolis, destined to supply the Bulgarian market.

item.title: Wison New Energies holds hull launching ceremony
item.description: Wison New Energies has held the Genting FLNG project hull launching ceremony and 10 million manhours LTI free celebration at its Nantong Yard.

item.title: Supermajority of Louisiana State Senators express support for LNG export facility
item.description: A supermajority of 36 Louisiana State Senators has adopted a resolution expressing full support for the development, construction, and long-term operation of Argent LNG, an LNG export facility in Port Fourchon, the US.

item.title: CIMC selects TMC Compressors for Golar FLNG facility
item.description: CIMC Raffles has contracted TMC Compressors to deliver a complete marine compressed air system to the MK2 FLNG facility being constructed for Golar LNG Ltd.

item.title: Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corp. orders three LNG carriers
item.description: Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corp. has ordered three latest technology LNG carriers to be built at HD Hyundai Samho Co., Ltd, scheduled for delivery in 2028 and 2029.

item.title: CIMC SOE holds keel-laying ceremony for LNG bunkering vessel
item.description: Nantong CIMC Sinopacific Offshore & Engineering Co., Ltd has held the keel-laying ceremony for a 12 500 m3 LNG bunker built for Vitol International Shipping.

item.title: QatarEnergy and EGAS sign MoU
item.description: QatarEnergy has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources of the Arab Republic of Egypt, with special focus on the supply of LNG to Egypt.

item.title: Honeywell to provide technology solutions for Commonwealth LNG
item.description: Honeywell has announced an agreement with Technip Energies to provide integrated LNG pretreatment and liquefaction solutions for Commonwealth LNG’s planned export facility in Louisiana, the US.

item.title: RMK Marine begins work on LNG bunkering vessel
item.description: RMK Marine has celebrate the steel cutting ceremony for an LNG bunkering vessel commissioned by Sirius Shipping and Gasum.

item.title: GTT receives order from Hanwha Ocean for seven new LNG carriers
item.description: GTT has received an order from the shipyard Hanwha Ocean for the tank design of seven new LNG carriers on behalf of a European shipowner.
